title: Vegan Mushroom and Leek Risotto
subtitle: with Toasted Walnuts and Rocket
description: This vegan-friendly risotto combines pan-fried mushrooms and leek for a hearty meal. There's no cheese, but it's still rich and creamy, and packs a flavour bomb with umami-laden mushrooms, peppery rocket and crunchy walnuts.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Halve the leek lengthwise and thinly slice the pale stem (see Kitchen 101). Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Thinly slice the mushrooms. Crumble the stock cubes into a heatproof jug, add 500ml (2 cups) boiling water and stir to dissolve.

Toast walnuts: Put the walnuts in a cold medium deep frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan and cool slightly, then coarsely chop. Heat 1 tbs olive oil in the same pan over medium heat. Cook the leek and garlic, stirring, for 3 mins or until softened.

Pan-fry mushrooms: Add the mushrooms and 2 tsp olive oil to the leek and cook, stirring occasionally, for 6-7 mins until the mushrooms are softened. Season with salt and pepper. Add the rice and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until the grains are well coated.

Add stock: Add the stock to the pan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10 mins. Remove the lid and cook for a further 5 mins or until the liquid is almost absorbed. Add the peas and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2-3 mins until the peas and rice are tender. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Meanwhile, put 2 tsp olive oil and 2 tsp red wine vinegar in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine. Add the rocket and toss to coat. Divide the risotto among bowls, top with the rocket and scatter over the walnuts. Enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Prior to chopping, give the pale part of the leek a good rinse under running water to remove any hidden dirt.
